welcome: Hello! I am your agricultural assistant. How can I help you today?
disclaimerText: AI-generated content. Please verify information independently.
questions: Will the weather be suitable for sowing wheat in Amber next week?
What is the current price of wheat in Amber market of Amhara Region?

capabilities: Get information on Ethiopian crop cultivation practices and techniques.
Learn about pest and disease management for common crops.
Access guidance on fertilization, irrigation, and harvesting methods.
limitations: Information is based on general agricultural best practices for Ethiopia.
Real-time market prices and weather forecasts are not available.
For location-specific advice, please consult local agricultural extension officers.
